Telemetry_Info_Message:
This feature sends anonymous data to help improve Ragnaକଣ୍ଟ୍ରୋଲର:

• App version and operating system
• Crash reports with stack traces
• Basic usage statistics (no personal data)

ନା sensitive information like usernames, passwords, or game progress is collected.

Data is sent via Discord Webhook for easy monitoring.

Tut.1_Desc: Welcome to Ragnaକଣ୍ଟ୍ରୋଲର! This tutorial will help you get started.
Tut_2_Desc: Tired of missing tiny items? When you open your inventory, use the D-ପ୍ୟାଡ୍ to snap the cursor perfectly from slot to slot. ଦବାନ୍ତୁ 'A' to double-click and equip items instantly.
Tut_3_Desc: Casting Storm Gust has never been easier. ଧରନ୍ତୁ down your skill button (e.g., L1+A). The targeting circle appears. Aim with the right stick. Simply RELEASE the button to cast the spell!
Tut_4_Desc: Having trouble clicking on a fast-moving Poring? Just tilt the ଡାହିଣ ଷ୍ଟିକ୍ slightly towards the monster and click R3. The engine will fire a micro-spiral click, guaranteeing a hit on the hitbox.
Tut_5_Desc: Need complex combos? ରେକର୍ଡ୍ your key presses, then open the Visual Timeline ସଂପାଦନ କରନ୍ତୁor. You can drag and drop the delays perfectly to match the server's lag and your character's ASPD.
